newsitem.title: GERMANY: Summary of Ifo Feb German business survey.
newsitem.headline: Summary of Ifo Feb German business survey.

text.p: Following is a summary of key points in the Ifo economic research institute's monthly business survey for February (sectors are west German unless otherwise stated, comparisons are against pvs month).
Ifo said on Tuesday that its business climate index for west Germany rose to 93.6 in February from 93.3 in January. In east Germany, the index fell to 104.1 from 106.5.
Orders levels - unchanged, but again more optimistic
Current business - still improving, nearly satisfactory
Export outlook - less optimistic, although competitive
Production plans - growth to lose some momentum
Note - In chemicals situation still seen as good; metals -- less negative; pulp and paper -- again less optimistic; textiles -- higher demand and good prospects.
Orders level - slight increase and increased output
Export outlook - unreduced optimism, competitiveness seen improved

Note - In machine-building situation still unfavourable, weak confidence; electricals -- export remain bright, lively order activity; vehicles -- continuation of economic progress; precision mechanical/optical sector -- more pessimistic.

Note - Carmakers said orders rising strong, expect more pronounced growth opportunities; electronics -- less optimistic, but situation has recovered somewhat. Output plans barely less restrictive; precision mechanical/optical -- considerably worse.
Business outlook - as bad as earlier this year
Export outlook - provides only small hope
Note - Clothing sector current business continues to improve, export opportunities growing; shoes -- less pessimistic; consumer textiles -- worsened.
Business outlook - contiued to view with scepticism
Orders level - 2.7 months output, up slightly on year ago
Prices - pressure increasing, more widespread expectation of falling prices
Personnel plans - pace of dismissals to continue unchanged
Current business - turnover down, situation clearly less favourable
Current business - satisfactory for first time in 1 1/2 years Business outlook - confidence outweighs pessimism, but not as strong as before
Production plans - rising, to increase slightly
Personnel plans - 0.5 percent job cuts expected
